sources.title: google/gemma-3n-E2B-it model card
sources.evidence: The public card identifies the E2B instruction-tuned model in Google's Gemma family and the Gemma license. Its statement that this model has 6B raw parameters conflicts with Google's E2B parameter diagram and the repository's BF16 metadata. The card is visible although raw files require authorization. Reopened for the parameter re-audit: the card still calls the raw size 6B and the effective size 2B, with PLE memory offloading; it does not separately define a per-token active count.

sources.title: Gemma 3n model card
sources.evidence: Describes open pretrained and instruction-tuned Gemma 3n models, text/image/video/audio input and text output, and a shared 32K input-plus-output budget. It reports reasoning benchmarks but does not establish a dedicated thinking mode or an E2B IT tool-use specification. Fresh parameter review: its selective-activation language describes 2B/4B effective sizes and links the overview for the memory definition; its benchmark tables do not publish a separate E2B active-parameter count.

sources.title: Introducing Gemma 3n: The developer guide
sources.evidence: Dated June 26, 2025; announces the full release after May's preview and standalone E2B extraction from jointly trained E4B. Calls E2B's complete count approximately 5B and its accelerator-memory equivalent approximately 2B. Identifies MatFormer, PLE, LAuReL, AltUp, MobileNet-v5 vision and USM-derived audio. Freshly reopened: Mix-n-Match changes FFN width and skips layers, so the larger E4B total or any E4B-only count cannot be transferred unchanged to the extracted E2B.

sources.title: Gemma 3n model overview
sources.evidence: Explains that E2B is an effective-memory label rather than total size. PLE can be cached and visual/audio parameters skipped or loaded conditionally. The nested E2B path is contained in E4B; this does not make every complete E2B checkpoint parameter active for every token. Freshly reopened for total, active, component and lineage checks: the E prefix explicitly denotes effective parameters that can be loaded in memory. MatFormer selects nested model configurations, rather than establishing token-wise MoE routing.

sources.title: Gemma 3n E2B parameter-usage diagram
sources.evidence: Visually inspected Figure 1 linked from the model overview: standard execution loads 5.44B parameters, split into text 1.91B, vision 0.30B, audio 0.68B and per-layer embedding 2.55B. Skipping vision/audio and caching PLE leaves 1.91B loaded. These are rounded parameter-memory categories, not a per-token active-count definition. Downloaded and visually rechecked during this re-audit; both 5.44B and 1.91B are labeled parameters loaded.

sources.title: Public metadata for Google's E2B IT checkpoint
sources.evidence: Revision 5e092ebca197cdcd8d8b195040accf22693501bc reports 5,439,438,272 BF16 safetensors elements and Gemma3nForConditionalGeneration. All reported storage is BF16, with no packed quantization dtype. This aggregate corroborates 5.44B rounded but does not expose names/shapes needed to independently exclude every buffer or verify tied-weight deduplication. Repository creation on June 12 is not evidence of public release.

sources.title: E2B IT checkpoint file metadata at audited revision
sources.evidence: Lists config, index and three safetensors shards. The current checkpoint includes a July 10 MobileNet weights fix; remaining shard metadata records June 25 preparation. This is a later corrected revision of the June release, not proof that the May preview and June checkpoint are identical.

sources.title: Gemma 3n fully available in the open-source ecosystem!
sources.evidence: June 26, 2025 release article from the implementation/hosting partner explicitly lists google/gemma-3n-e2b-it among the models released that day, separately from the earlier preview. Describes the language decoder, MobileNet-v5 vision and audio encoders.

sources.title: On-device small language models with multimodality, RAG, and Function Calling
sources.evidence: May 20, 2025 announcement links its E2B preview specifically to google/gemma-3n-E2B-it-litert-preview and says text/image are available with audio forthcoming. It also announces generic AI Edge function-calling libraries; it does not provide an exact non-preview E2B IT capability assertion or demonstration.

sources.title: Google Gemma 3n E2B LiteRT preview model card
sources.evidence: Public HTML read directly: identifies this repository as the Preview version for Google AI Edge and says that its current checkpoint supports only text and vision. It is a distinct preview artifact; no weight-identity bridge to the complete June BF16 E2B IT checkpoint was established.

sources.title: Transformers Gemma3n configuration implementation
sources.evidence: Launch-era reference implementation specifies a 32,768-position text context by default and separate text/audio/vision configurations. This makes Google's 32K context convention explicit; it is not a substitute for the gated exact checkpoint config.

sources.title: Transformers Gemma3n model implementation
sources.evidence: Declares lm_head.weight tied, builds text/audio/vision modules and modality projections, and marks its explicit scale/position/mask buffers nonpersistent. Therefore one must not add another output embedding matrix. Exact checkpoint headers and vision-tower state were unavailable for a complete element-level learned-parameter audit.

sources.title: Gated E2B IT tensor index
sources.evidence: HTTP 401 for the exact revision's config and tensor index, and for a bytes=0-7 request to the first safetensors shard. No whole shard was downloaded. Individual tensor classification and exact unique learned count remain unverified.

sources.title: Gemma Terms of Use
sources.evidence: The license linked by the Gemma 3n model card is titled Gemma Terms of Use; it governs use, modification and distribution of the model weights.

sources.title: Pinned E2B IT checkpoint public metadata
sources.evidence: Fresh metadata request returned revision 5e092ebca197cdcd8d8b195040accf22693501bc and 5,439,438,272 BF16 safetensors elements. This corroborates the published rounded 5.44B complete count. No weight shard was downloaded and no repeated tensor census was attempted.

sources.title: KerasHub Gemma3nCausalLM presets
sources.evidence: Freshly opened preset table explicitly assigns gemma3n_e2b_it 5.44B parameters and describes approximately 5B total with approximately 2B effective size. The E2B pretrained preset has the same 5.44B nominal total; E4B is separately listed as 7.85B. This implementation documentation corroborates the Google diagram without establishing a per-token active count.

sources.title: Gemma 4 Technical Report
sources.evidence: Later primary report checked for retrospective Gemma 3n specifications. Section 2.2 and the audio comparison table identify the Gemma 3n E2B audio encoder as 680M parameters, corroborating the 0.68B component. The comparison does not publish a full E2B active count. Gemma 4 26B-A4B active-size claims concern a different architecture/model and are not inherited.

sources.title: Gemma 3n E2B IT model listing
sources.evidence: Numeric lead found by a fresh exact-model active-parameters search and opened. Claims 5.44B total and 2.0B active per token while incorrectly labeling Gemma 3n E2B as MoE. Its Sources link opens a generic methodology page rather than parameter-specific evidence. The 2B claim is not adopted: Google defines the E2B label as effective memory and no original nominal active-count convention is supplied here.

sources.title: Gemma 3n E2B IT model listing
sources.evidence: Fresh numeric lead claims 6B active parameters and a MoE architecture, without an explained active-count convention. Its Read the Paper link resolves to arXiv 2503.07827, Modern Models, Medieval Texts: A POS Tagging Study of Old Occitan, published before Gemma 3n and unrelated to it. The 6B active claim is therefore unsupported and conflicts with the primary MatFormer description.

sources.title: Gemma 3n MatFormer Lab notebook
sources.evidence: Freshly fetched the notebook linked by Google. It explicitly defines E4B as effectively loading 4B parameters and E2B as its 30-layer, FFN-width-8192 nested model. The extraction code slices layers, FFNs and PLE projections/embeddings. Diagnostic comments show 5,976,833,408 total, 4,456,156,768 text and 1,905,495,648 effective parameters, with effective explicitly excluding vision, audio and per-layer embeddings. These comments are not a separately defined active count and do not identify the pinned current checkpoint revision; the total differs from the current 5.44B diagram, Keras preset and metadata. The documented extraction establishes lineage while also showing why E4B counts cannot transfer unchanged.

name.note: Exact E2B instruction-tuned variant, distinct from E4B, pretrained E2B, and LiteRT preview artifacts.

developer.note: Google publishes the weights; the model card identifies Google DeepMind as the author.

family.note: Gemma 3n belongs to Google's Gemma family.

release_date.note: Complete E2B IT release. The May 20 E2B release points to the distinct LiteRT preview supporting text/vision only. No source established checkpoint identity with the complete June text/image/audio/video model, so its earlier date is not transferred.

open_weights.note: Google distributes the model weights subject to Gemma terms and access acceptance; gating does not change the open-weight classification.

license.note: Named license linked by the official model card, confirmed independently of code-library licensing.

parameters_b.note: Retain the published rounded 5.44B complete E2B count: Google’s diagram includes text, vision, audio and PLE, the exact Keras IT preset independently lists 5.44B, and pinned checkpoint metadata corroborates the rounding. A nominal published total does not require a new exact tensor census. The card’s 6B wording and MatFormer notebook diagnostic comments conflict with the diagram/current metadata and are not substituted. E2B/1.91B denotes effective memory, not this total; E4B has a structurally larger configuration.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh exact-model total, active, component and named-base searches; reopened original Google material, Keras presets and MatFormer Lab, and checked the later Gemma 4 report’s comparison tables. No primary source or original research-team comparison establishes a separately defined nominal per-token active count for E2B IT. Google’s 1.91B is loaded memory after caching PLE and skipping audio/vision; the notebook likewise calls its count effective and excludes those components. This is not a demand for an exact census. The 2B-active and 6B-active aggregator leads supply no sound convention and misclassify MatFormer as MoE; ApX’s linked paper is unrelated. E2B’s documented extraction changes the E4B structure, and no supported active count for an identical named base was found. Keep active size null rather than convert memory loading into active computation.

architecture.note: MatFormer nested Transformer language decoder with PLE, AltUp, LAuReL and KV sharing, plus MobileNet-v5 vision and USM-derived audio encoders. E2B is the extracted smaller path trained within E4B; nesting, activation sparsity and conditional modality loading do not by themselves establish mixture-of-experts routing.

context_window.note: Google specifies a shared 32K-token input/output budget; the launch-era reference configuration spells that out as 32,768 positions. Output allowance is reduced by input length.

modalities.note: The complete release explicitly includes video as well as text, image and audio input. Outputs are text; individual serving implementations may support a subset.

reasoning.note: General reasoning benchmarks and chain-of-thought prompting are reported, but no dedicated reasoning/thinking-mode classification for this exact variant was established. Clear the unsupported false baseline rather than infer capability absence from its ordinary chat template.

tool_call.note: No exact complete E2B IT prompted or native tool-use claim was verified. Google's May article pairs Gemma 3n with general Edge function-calling libraries, but does not establish this checkpoint's capability. Absence of native tool tokens is not evidence of false, and examples for Gemma 3 4B or Gemma 4 are not transferred.

description.value: Instruction-tuned Gemma 3n E2B model with a MatFormer Transformer, text, image, audio and video input, and text output.
description.note: Plain description of the exact variant, architecture and documented modalities.

patch.description: Instruction-tuned Gemma 3n E2B model with a MatFormer Transformer, text, image, audio and video input, and text output.

sources.label: Google E2B IT weights and card

patch.notes: 5.44B is Google’s rounded complete E2B count, including text, vision, audio and per-layer embeddings, corroborated by Keras and checkpoint metadata. E2B and 1.91B describe effective memory loading; a separate per-token active count is undisclosed. The model card’s 6B figure conflicts with those sources. June 26 dates the complete release; May offered a separate text/vision LiteRT preview.

summary: Fresh parameter re-audit retains the supported nominal 5.44B complete total and explicitly keeps active parameters null. Reopened Google sources and inspected the parameter diagram; checked pinned metadata, Keras presets, MatFormer extraction lineage and later Google comparison tables. These establish total size and memory/component conventions, including the 680M audio encoder, but no separately supported E2B active count. Investigated and rejected concrete 2B-active and 6B-active aggregator leads because their MoE classification and attribution are unsupported. No weights downloaded or repeated tensor census. Existing nonparameter assessments and rounded component values are preserved.
